runtime_sources.source: Optional local CSV assigning acquisition sessions independently of plates. Use an exact filename column, including each merged NPY or selected reference TIFF/NPY suffix, and the selected session column. Every current sample and reference file must have one unique nonblank assignment. Blank keeps one session per plate. Default blank.

Exact column name in the sessions CSV that identifies an acquisition session. All fields in a session share reference gains and must use compatible measurement intensity planes and working units. Default session.

Optional local folder of bead or reference-well images, replacing reference images inside the measured folder. Filenames keep the plate, well and field identity; selected reference wells still apply. NPY files use the merged channel and mask layout. TIFF files contain only intensity channels with explicit spatial and channel axes. No time or ambiguous page-axis interpretation is guessed. Default blank.

Exact acquisition session identifier to use as the gain reference. Blank uses the first session by name, or the sole session on the explicitly selected reference plate. If both plate and session are selected they must agree. A plate assigned to multiple sessions requires this choice. Default blank.

Calibrate intensities before measuring, using beads or reference wells acquired in each imaging session. By default each plate is a session. An optional sessions CSV assigns fields independently of plates; an external bead folder can supply the reference images. Gains match the selected reference session or plate; blank choices keep the first-by-name default. The existing camera-offset gain method is unchanged. Gains and reference content identities are recorded in measurements.db:intensity_rescale. Default False.
runtime_sources.old_source: Calibrate intensities across imaging sessions before measuring: each plate is one session, the beads or reference wells imaged on every plate are measured, and every plate's intensity channels are scaled so its reference wells match the selected reference plate's; a blank reference plate setting uses the first plate by name. This corrects exposure, lamp and detector drift between days at the image level, unlike batch correction of tables. The gains are recorded in measurements.db:intensity_rescale. Default False.

runtime_sources.source: Wells holding the same calibration sample in each acquisition session, such as ['A01'] or ['A01', 'P24']. References come from the selected external bead folder, or otherwise the measured merged folder. Every measured session must have a usable reference field. In-source reference wells are measured like any other well. Default None.
runtime_sources.old_source: The wells holding the calibration sample, imaged on every plate with the same sample: fluorescent beads or a reference stain, such as ['A01'] or ['A01', 'P24']. Every plate must have at least one field in them, or the run stops. They are measured and calibrated like any other well. Default None.

runtime_sources.source: Exact reference plate identifier from merged filenames, such as plate2. Without a sessions CSV, blank keeps the first plate by name. With explicit sessions, this plate must belong to one session, or pair it with an exact reference session on that plate. The selected plate must be present in the measured run. Default blank.
runtime_sources.old_source: Reference plate identifier from the merged filenames, such as plate2. Leave blank to use the first plate by name. The selected plate must be present in this run. Default blank.

runtime_sources.source: How each reference field intensity is summarised after subtracting intensity_calibration_offset. foreground is the median above Otsu for sparse beads on a dark background; median uses all pixels for a uniformly stained reference well. old_record.translation: मापन से पहले इमेजिंग सत्रों के बीच तीव्रताओं का अंशांकन करें: हर प्लेट एक सत्र है, हर प्लेट पर इमेज किए गए बीड या संदर्भ वेल मापे जाते हैं, और हर प्लेट के तीव्रता चैनल इस तरह स्केल होते हैं कि उसके संदर्भ वेल चुनी गई संदर्भ प्लेट से मेल खाएँ; संदर्भ प्लेट की सेटिंग खाली होने पर नाम के क्रम में पहली प्लेट का उपयोग होता है। यह तालिकाओं के बैच सुधार के विपरीत, छवि स्तर पर दिनों के बीच एक्सपोज़र, लैंप और डिटेक्टर के विचलन को सुधारता है। गेन measurements.db:intensity_rescale में दर्ज होते हैं। डिफ़ॉल्ट False।

old_record.translation: intensity_calibration_offset घटाने के बाद हर संदर्भ छवि क्षेत्र की तीव्रता का सार कैसे निकाला जाता है। foreground: Otsu सीमा से ऊपर के पिक्सेल की माध्यिका, अंधेरी पृष्ठभूमि पर बिखरे बीड के लिए। median: सभी पिक्सेल की माध्यिका, समान रूप से स्टेन किए गए संदर्भ वेल के लिए। हर प्लेट अपने संदर्भ छवि क्षेत्रों पर माध्यिका उपयोग करती है। डिफ़ॉल्ट foreground।

old_record.source: Calibrate intensities across imaging sessions before measuring: each plate is one session, the beads or reference wells imaged on every plate are measured, and every plate's intensity channels are scaled so its reference wells match the selected reference plate's; a blank reference plate setting uses the first plate by name. This corrects exposure, lamp and detector drift between days at the image level, unlike batch correction of tables. The gains are recorded in measurements.db:intensity_rescale. Default False.
old_record.translation: Kalibriert Intensitäten über Bildgebungssitzungen hinweg vor der Messung: Jede Platte ist eine Sitzung, die auf jeder Platte aufgenommenen Beads oder Referenz-Wells werden gemessen, und die Intensitätskanäle jeder Platte werden so skaliert, dass ihre Referenz-Wells denen der gewählten Referenzplatte entsprechen; bei leerer Referenzplatten-Einstellung wird die erste Platte nach Namen verwendet. Chaque plaque doit y avoir au moins un champ, sinon l’exécution s’arrête. Ils sont mesurés et calibrés comme n’importe quel autre puits. Valeur par défaut : None.

old_record.source: Calibrate intensities across imaging sessions before measuring: each plate is one session, the beads or reference wells imaged on every plate are measured, and every plate's intensity channels are scaled so its reference wells match the selected reference plate's; a blank reference plate setting uses the first plate by name. This corrects exposure, lamp and detector drift between days at the image level, unlike batch correction of tables. The gains are recorded in measurements.db:intensity_rescale. Default False.
old_record.translation: Calibre les intensités entre sessions d’imagerie avant la mesure : chaque plaque est une session, les billes ou puits de référence imagés sur chaque plaque sont mesurés, et les canaux d’intensité de chaque plaque sont mis à l’échelle pour que ses puits de référence correspondent à ceux de la plaque de référence sélectionnée ; si le réglage de plaque de référence est vide, la première plaque par nom est utilisée. Cela corrige la dérive d’exposition, de lampe et de détecteur d’un jour à l’autre au niveau de l’image, contrairement à une correction de lot des tables. Les gains sont enregistrés dans measurements.db:intensity_rescale. Valeur par défaut : False.

old_record.translation: intensity_calibration_offset 값을 뺀 뒤 각 기준 시야의 강도를 요약하는 방식입니다. foreground: 어두운 배경의 드문 비드용으로, Otsu 임계값 위 픽셀의 중앙값입니다. median: 균일하게 염색된 기준 웰용으로, 모든 픽셀의 중앙값입니다. 각 플레이트는 기준 시야들의 중앙값을 씁니다. 기본값 foreground.

old_record.translation: 보정 시료가 있는 웰로, 모든 플레이트에서 같은 시료로 촬영합니다. 형광 비드나 기준 염색이며, 예: ['A01'] 또는 ['A01', 'P24']. 모든 플레이트는 이 웰에 시야가 하나 이상 있어야 하며, 없으면 실행이 멈춥니다. 다른 웰처럼 측정되고 보정됩니다. 기본값 None.

old_record.translation: 측정 전에 촬영 세션 간 강도를 보정합니다. 각 플레이트가 한 세션이며, 모든 플레이트에서 촬영한 비드나 기준 웰을 측정하고, 기준 웰이 선택한 기준 플레이트와 같아지도록 각 플레이트의 강도 채널을 조정합니다. 기준 플레이트 설정이 비어 있으면 이름순으로 첫 번째 플레이트를 사용합니다. 표의 배치 보정과 달리 이미지 수준에서 날짜 간 노출, 광원, 검출기 드리프트를 보정합니다. 이득은 measurements.db:intensity_rescale에 기록됩니다. 기본값 False.

old_record.translation: Calibra intensidades entre sessões de aquisição antes da medição: cada placa é uma sessão, as microesferas ou poços de referência imageados em cada placa são medidos, e os canais de intensidade de cada placa são escalados para que seus poços de referência coincidam com os da placa de referência selecionada; se a configuração da placa de referência estiver vazia, usa-se a primeira placa por nome. old_record.source: How each reference field's intensity is summarised, after subtracting intensity_calibration_offset. foreground: the median of the pixels above an Otsu threshold, for sparse beads on a dark background. median: the median of all pixels, for a uniformly stained reference well. Each plate uses the median over its reference fields. Default foreground.
old_record.translation: Como a intensidade de cada campo de referência é resumida, após subtrair intensity_calibration_offset. foreground: a mediana dos pixels acima de um limiar de Otsu, para microesferas esparsas em fundo escuro. median: a mediana de todos os pixels, para um poço de referência corado de forma uniforme. Cada placa usa a mediana dos seus campos de referência. Padrão foreground.

old_record.source: The wells holding the calibration sample, imaged on every plate with the same sample: fluorescent beads or a reference stain, such as ['A01'] or ['A01', 'P24']. Every plate must have at least one field in them, or the run stops. They are measured and calibrated like any other well. Default None.
old_record.translation: Os poços com a amostra de calibração, imageada em cada placa com a mesma amostra: microesferas fluorescentes ou uma coloração de referência, como ['A01'] ou ['A01', 'P24']. Cada placa precisa ter pelo menos um campo neles, ou a execução para. Eles são medidos e calibrados como qualquer outro poço. Padrão None.

old_record.source: Reference plate identifier from the merged filenames, such as plate2. Leave blank to use the first plate by name. The selected plate must be present in this run. Default blank.
old_record.translation: Referensplattans identifierare i de sammanslagna filnamnen, till exempel plate2. Lämna tomt för att använda den första plattan i namnordning. Den valda plattan måste finnas i den här körningen. Standard: tomt.

old_record.source: Calibrate intensities across imaging sessions before measuring: each plate is one session, the beads or reference wells imaged on every plate are measured, and every plate's intensity channels are scaled so its reference wells match the selected reference plate's; a blank reference plate setting uses the first plate by name. This corrects exposure, lamp and detector drift between days at the image level, unlike batch correction of tables. The gains are recorded in measurements.db:intensity_rescale. Default False.
old_record.translation: Kalibrerar intensiteter mellan avbildningssessioner före mätningen: varje platta är en session, de pärlor eller referensbrunnar som avbildats på varje platta mäts, och varje plattas intensitetskanaler skalas så att dess referensbrunnar matchar den valda referensplattans; om inställningen för referensplatta är tom används den första plattan efter namn. Detta korrigerar exponerings-, lamp- och detektordrift mellan dagar på bildnivå, till skillnad från batchkorrigering av tabeller. Förstärkningarna sparas i measurements.db:intensity_rescale. Standard False.

old_record.source: How each reference field's intensity is summarised, after subtracting intensity_calibration_offset. foreground: the median of the pixels above an Otsu threshold, for sparse beads on a dark background. median: the median of all pixels, for a uniformly stained reference well. Each plate uses the median over its reference fields. Default foreground.
old_record.translation: Hur varje referensbildfälts intensitet sammanfattas, efter att intensity_calibration_offset dragits bort. foreground: medianen av pixlarna över en Otsu-tröskel, för glesa pärlor på mörk bakgrund. median: medianen av alla pixlar, för en jämnt färgad referensbrunn. Varje platta använder medianen över sina referensbildfält. Standard foreground.

old_record.source: The wells holding the calibration sample, imaged on every plate with the same sample: fluorescent beads or a reference stain, such as ['A01'] or ['A01', 'P24']. Every plate must have at least one field in them, or the run stops. They are measured and calibrated like any other well. Default None.
old_record.translation: Brunnarna med kalibreringsprovet, avbildade på varje platta med samma prov: fluorescerande pärlor eller en referensfärgning, till exempel ['A01'] eller ['A01', 'P24']. Varje platta måste ha minst ett bildfält i dem, annars stoppas körningen. De mäts och kalibreras som alla andra brunnar. Standard None.

old_record.source: How each reference field's intensity is summarised, after subtracting intensity_calibration_offset. foreground: the median of the pixels above an Otsu threshold, for sparse beads on a dark background. median: the median of all pixels, for a uniformly stained reference well. Each plate uses the median over its reference fields. Default foreground.
old_record.translation: Cómo se resume la intensidad de cada campo de referencia tras restar intensity_calibration_offset. foreground: la mediana de los píxeles por encima de un umbral de Otsu, para microesferas dispersas sobre fondo oscuro. median: la mediana de todos los píxeles, para un pocillo de referencia teñido de forma uniforme. Cada placa usa la mediana de sus campos de referencia. Valor predeterminado: foreground.

old_record.source: The wells holding the calibration sample, imaged on every plate with the same sample: fluorescent beads or a reference stain, such as ['A01'] or ['A01', 'P24']. Every plate must have at least one field in them, or the run stops. They are measured and calibrated like any other well. Default None.
old_record.translation: Los pocillos con la muestra de calibración, fotografiada en cada placa con la misma muestra: microesferas fluorescentes o una tinción de referencia, como ['A01'] o ['A01', 'P24']. Cada placa debe tener al menos un campo en ellos, o la ejecución se detiene. Se miden y calibran como cualquier otro pocillo. Valor predeterminado: None.

old_record.source: Reference plate identifier from the merged filenames, such as plate2. Leave blank to use the first plate by name. The selected plate must be present in this run. Default blank.
old_record.translation: Identificador de la placa de referencia en los nombres de los archivos combinados, como plate2. Deje el campo vacío para usar la primera placa por orden de nombre. La placa seleccionada debe estar presente en esta ejecución. Predeterminado: vacío.

old_record.source: Calibrate intensities across imaging sessions before measuring: each plate is one session, the beads or reference wells imaged on every plate are measured, and every plate's intensity channels are scaled so its reference wells match the selected reference plate's; a blank reference plate setting uses the first plate by name. This corrects exposure, lamp and detector drift between days at the image level, unlike batch correction of tables. The gains are recorded in measurements.db:intensity_rescale. Default False.
old_record.translation: Calibra intensidades entre sesiones de adquisición antes de medir: cada placa es una sesión, se miden las microesferas o pocillos de referencia fotografiados en cada placa, y los canales de intensidad de cada placa se escalan para que sus pocillos de referencia coincidan con los de la placa de referencia seleccionada; si el ajuste de placa de referencia está vacío, se usa la primera placa por nombre. Esto corrige la deriva de exposición, lámpara y detector entre días a nivel de imagen, a diferencia de la corrección de lotes de las tablas. Las ganancias se registran en measurements.db:intensity_rescale. Valor predeterminado: False.
